assumptions.statement: Synthetic profile labels and the post validation flag do not establish real machine/controller/material/tool/post applicability; lifecycle reviews and tool availability remain unresolved.

The linked CAD design intent and full stock/feature-to-operation plan are not established by the supplied rectangular NC; actual stock condition, tolerances, access and inspection acceptance need qualified review.
Datum/WCS verification, coordinate mapping and initial position, fixture/tool-holder geometry and clamp clearance are unverified; no physical motion or collision verification is supplied.
The NC header claims revision C while the selected CNC job and submitted artifact descriptor remain revision B; linked CAD revision A is a separate source identity.

verification.summary: Offline reports retained; required context/simulation/review is unresolved. No physical verification.

simulation.reason: Only offline static/routing evidence is available; no applicable simulation has been performed.
required_checks: Target/controller/post compatibility for exact reviewed NC bytes and versions
Complete path and tool-change/approach/retract motion against reviewed machine, fixture and tool/holder geometry and coordinate context
Stock-removal and feature coverage against controlled design, material/stock condition and setup sequence

human_review.action: Ask the design/CAM authority which job/output revision is intended, trace the generation chain, reconcile controlled inputs and regenerate/review as needed; preserve the conflict instead of relabeling to pass.
human_review.reviewer_role: Qualified design authority, CAM programmer, tooling/setup and manufacturing reviewers
